method.ipr: in-memory render of iprRenderServer (TIFF export pixels), no file written
method.lr: Lightroom TIFF references of tests/image/base (IPR Lumieres complet presets)
method.zone: 10 % brightest pixels of each engine's own neutral, block mean 8x8
method.criterion: mean CIE L* of the zone in the variant, IPR minus LR
method.highlight_scenes: share of LR neutral pixels with Y >= 0.41 at least 0.05
